current.title: Round 60 DELIVERED — the second owner-feedback polish round (0.60.0)
current.detail: The owner's thirteenth Windows test session confirmed the rounded window PERFECT ('It looks way too good, even better than what I imagined it to be or hoped for it to be… keep it as a part of our design language') and the pop-out browser satisfying ('fully satisfied… the same clean beautiful UI which I wanted'); the session's polish list became this round: the pop-out VIEW is rounded (a bordered card in the design language), the pop-out scrollbar moved OUTSIDE the content card (the window's own gutter scrollbar — drag/click/keyboard, driven by the new browser_tab_scroll_state/scroll_to/set_zoom Tauri commands via eval_with_callback; themed pill CSS injected at document start on every page, honest single-scrollbar fallback on CSP-strict sites), the API-key field is one consistent row (same-slot eye, smooth Copy, Rotate deleted — paste-to-replace), the models list starts EMPTY with the Free/All toggle in the Add-models picker, settings padding stripped + the scroll-reflow width-shift fixed (stable scrollbar gutter), the sidebar's logo + collapse button deleted in favor of the TITLE-BAR identity toggle (global visibility, chat routes included), the new-tab popover renders ABOVE the browser preview (webview yields via popover-webview-guard), and the browser panel's zoom actually zooms (real DPI zoom — the R50 approximation deleted). Verification: 1348/1348 tests in 91 files, lint/typecheck clean, LIVE agent-browser battery (empty models default, picker free-only default, add/delete model round-trip, key reveal/hide/paste-cancel with zero PUTs, stable scrollbar styles, full-width settings, sidebar toggle on dashboard + chat, popout.html 200, zero console errors); Rust doc-verified against tauri 2.11.5 with CI cargo check as the compile gate.
